title: Current: modular voice and audio-host boundaries
notes: Refactor branch introduces a common playable-voice contract and registry, centralizes device output/FX-send/record-tap routing behind AudioHost, and migrates GlassPolyVoice, DrumVoice, and SampleVoice to that boundary without changing sequencer timing semantics. CassioApp exposes the registry at its composition edge; deeper app.js decomposition remains a separate technical-debt pass.
